claimed_performance.basis: The vendor's own multi-site data, split-sample validation

development_population.description: Adult ward admissions at 14 hospitals in the vendor's development network

fictional: Venncroft and the Venncroft Deterioration Index are invented for the Tonmick Health practice world. Nothing here describes a real vendor, product or study.
inputs: Latest lactate (a normal value is assumed when none is on file)
Encounters at the customer's organisation in the last 12 months
intended_use: Adults admitted to a general ward. One score 12 hours after admission. Not for patients in intensive care or on comfort care at that time.
outcome_predicted: Unplanned transfer to intensive care, unplanned transfer to a higher level of care, or death, within 48 hours of the score.
score: 0 to 100; a higher score means a higher risk. vendor_risk_table.csv gives the vendor's stated risk at each score.

versions.note: Scored in silent mode at first; alert dates are in facilities.csv
Recalibration on pooled customer data. Inputs and alert threshold are unchanged. The score still runs from 0 to 100; its risk table is new. Customers were told to expect fewer alerts.
